text:
noah: opened a short PR adding a tiny 'compact envelope' example + a validator hint for function/tool outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5019

tia: thanks — can we show both a bare call and the envelope pattern? folks want a minimal canonical example.

omar: also include a one-line normalization for nullable lists (seen tools return null / single object). keeps downstream parsing stable.

noah: current minimal bare example in the draft:
```json
{"name":"fetch_invoice","arguments":{"invoice_id":"inv_99"}}
```
and the compact envelope we propose:
```json
{"call":{"name":"fetch_invoice","arguments":{"invoice_id":"inv_99"}},"meta":{"service":"billing","version":"v1"}}
```
tia: nice. add a 1-sentence guardrail note: prefer tolerating extra fields (forward compatibility), show `additionalProperties: true` in the schema snippet.

omar: shim for nullable lists I use everywhere:
```js
const list = Array.isArray(resp.items) ? resp.items : (resp.items ? [resp.items] : []);
```
helpful for single-object -> array normalization and null -> [].

runtime-bot: runtime note: we currently attach schema under `structured_output_schema`. planned rename tracked at runtime#782 — docs should reference the current key and mention the migration briefly.

noah: good catch, will reference `structured_output_schema` and link the runtime issue.

tia: tiny SDK helper (6 lines) please include; make sure the thrown message is stable so examples-tests can assert on it. show the exact error text.

noah: added a compact helper showing parse + deterministic error message:
```js
try {
  const parsed = parseStructuredOutput(resp, schema);
  return parsed;
} catch (e) {
  throw new Error("ParseError: missing required field 'invoice_id'");
}
```
qa-bot: note: examples-tests expect exactly `ParseError: missing required field 'invoice_id'` for the negative path.

tia: editorial nit: change single quotes inside the thrown string to match test harness (they already match). also add a 1-line sentence about preferring `meta` over `metadata` to keep envelopes compact.

omar: tiny extra: mention ignoring unknown fields vs failing; sample schema snippet: `"additionalProperties": true`.

noah: pushed commits: envelope, shim, SDK helper, runtime note. CI queued.

qa-bot: CI results: lint: pass, link-check: pass, examples-tests: pass.

tia: LGTM, approving now.

noah: thanks all — merging. docs build scheduled for next deploy. :shipit:
